stories.title: Automatic backups and guided recovery

acceptance_criteria.text: A valid backup restores separate boards with notes and relationships; retries return the same copies.
Invalid schema, damaged file, failed safety backup or failed insert leaves current boards unchanged.
Retain 14 backups, limit uploads to 32 MiB, expire previews after an hour.

observability: Recovery errors and backup timestamps appear in the UI
CI records installation and live API outcomes
manual_steps: Interactive installation and nontechnical user acceptance on actual devices
agent_constraints: Preserve user data; no direct main push or publication
migration_data: Migration 012 adds repeat fields and idempotent restore receipts; existing data is retained
rollback: Restoration creates separate boards; a pre-restore safety backup is required; do not downgrade a migrated database without retaining it.

stories.title: Deleted-task undo and repeating work

acceptance_criteria.text: Undo restores notes/checklists; completing daily, weekly or monthly work creates one next occurrence.
Stale Undo cannot restore a later deletion; failure creating the repeat rolls back completion.
Reopening/completing does not duplicate work; month-end and leap-year anchors survive edits.
